messages:
maria (partnerships): Heads up — OrionCloud just told me one manifest in EU region hit a customs hold, affecting ~120 GPUs for Dedicated commits scheduled next week. ETA unclear. cc @jin @omar

jin (supply-chain): On it. Can you paste the manifest id and carrier?

maria (partnerships): manifest: ORC-EU-4572
Carrier: BlueMarlin
ETA in system: 2026-03-30
They're saying paperwork mismatch (commercial invoice).

omar (ops): Thanks. I'll open a support ticket with carrier & customs broker. Quick Q: are these the racks reserved for Acme pilot or pooled capacity?

priya (acct-exec): They're for Acme pilot (Q2 ramp). Customer expects 2 racks on 3/31. If this slips we need to propose fallback.

jin (supply-chain): If manifest delayed >72h we can reassign 1 rack from the EU staging buffer (region pool). That will impact marketplace onboarding schedule though.

maria (partnerships): OrionCloud update: 'awaiting commercial invoice correction, estimated 24-72h.' They offered partial release but need us to confirm serial ranges.

omar (ops): I opened ticket INC-20260322-003 with carrier + broker. Carrier asks for serial ranges; can we confirm now?

maria (partnerships): Serial ranges in onboarding doc: S/N 9F3A-9F8C (racks 1-2), S/N 9F8D-9FF0 (racks 3-4). I'll DM the broker the ranges and invoice copy.

priya (acct-exec): :thinking_face: If 72h hits, can Acme accept degraded capacity? They need ~50% throughput for the initial burst.

jin (supply-chain): We can cover the first week via hosted fallback (public), but that's a cost/ops tradeoff. Jin note: estimate ~2x token cost for traffic moved to hosted for 10M tokens/day.

omar (ops): Ops can pre-warm endpoints and adjust scale policies, but we need model version, quantization profile, and expected token/sec. @maria can you confirm with Acme ASAP?

maria (partnerships): Reached out to Acme — they said hosted fallback OK for up to 10 days, prefer Dedicated after. Asking for model + traffic shape now.

logistics-bot: INC-20260322-003 status update: 'Documents submitted, customs processing begun.' ETA estimate: 48h.

priya (acct-exec): Great. Flagging sales/legal: if slip >5 days we should prep a crediting/dispute per contract. I'll loop in finance if needed.

maria (partnerships): Agreed. Per contract clause 6.2 we can request crediting for SLA/commit breach; I'll start the internal note to legal.

jin (supply-chain): Action items: 1) Omar to track ticket & confirm partial release options; 2) Maria to confirm serial ranges & Acme fallback; 3) Jin to evaluate buffer reassign & cost; 4) Priya to prep customer comms. Reconvene here in 6 hours. :clock6:

omar (ops): On it — will post carrier receipts and partial release options in this thread.

logistics-bot: INC-20260322-003 update 1727778999: 'Customs released 60 units (partial). Remaining 60 units pending additional paperwork.'
thread_summary: Customs hold on EU manifest ORC-EU-4572 affecting 120 GPUs; partial release for 60 units; team coordinating fallback (hosted), buffer reassign, customer comms, and contract crediting if delay extends.
